delivery_methodology: The project will be delivered using an AI-enabled agile approach characterized by short, time-boxed iterations with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. AI tools assist in drafting and automating routine tasks, while human experts review, integrate, and approve all outputs to ensure quality and alignment with requirements. This iterative process allows for incremental releases and controlled scope changes, fostering transparency and adaptability throughout the project lifecycle.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to implement a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to streamline HR operations and enhance management oversight. This system aims to improve data accuracy, reporting capabilities, and employee self-service functionalities, thereby supporting the company's strategic HR goals and operational efficiency.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution integrates key capabilities including employee information management, leave and attendance tracking, payroll interfacing, and robust reporting dashboards. It is designed for use by HR staff, management, and employees, aligning with Kalinaw Trading Corporation's workflows to facilitate efficient data management and decision-making. The solution supports online employee self-service for profile updates, leave applications, and document requests, while providing HR with tools for approvals, audit trails, and organizational structure maintenance.
technical_architecture: The system is architected as a cloud-deployed microservices platform utilizing Java with Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend interface, and PostgreSQL for data storage. It features layered application design with secure role-based access control, audit logging, and integration points for payroll systems. Separate environments for development, testing (UAT), and production ensure quality and stability. The architecture supports scalability to handle 300 concurrent users and meets performance and availability targets through efficient service orchestration and cloud infrastructure.
warranty_support: A warranty period will cover defect correction and system performance issues identified post-deployment, with a clear process for reporting and resolution. The warranty scope includes fixes for functionality delivered as part of the project, while enhancements or new features beyond the agreed scope are handled separately. This ensures Kalinaw Trading Corporation receives reliable support during the initial operational phase of the HRIS.
